bulk.title: Collection
bulk.subtitle: Search domains on the left, collection on the right, actions in tabs at the bottom. Any field can be a filter.
bulk.noneSelected: Click a domain on the left to add it.
bulk.updateHint: Match hosts with these filters (All / empty = ignore that field). Only filled patch fields are written.
bulk.addHint: Add multiple hosts to every domain in the collection at once. Skip any that already exist. For CNAME / ALIAS / NS you can check “use this domain” so each record points at itself, e.g. lucasyu.com.
bulk.deleteHint: Fill only Host or type to delete. Leave blank to ignore that field.
bulk.addressSelf: Use this domain as the target (no IP)
bulk.reviewHint: {{count}} affected records will be written. Cancel slides back.
bulk.confirmUpdate: On {{count}} domains, filter {{filter}}, change {{patch}}. Namecheap setHosts replaces each domain’s full host list.
bulk.confirmAdd: Add {{hosts}} on {{count}} domains. Namecheap setHosts replaces each domain’s full host list.
bulk.confirmDelete: On {{count}} domains, filter {{filter}} and delete matching records. Namecheap setHosts replaces each domain’s full host list.
